meta.title: 相机“光圈” 底层逻辑科普，光圈如何定义（一）

scenes.context: 我们常听到的光圈F1.4、F2.8、F4、F8、F16等等，这些说的其实是镜头的相对光圈值。这个数值越小代表实际的物理光圈越大，而数值越大则表示实际物理光圈越小。很多人可能会被这个相反的概念搞混，那我们不妨先看一下光圈的F值是如何定义的。
sentences: F1.4、F2.8这些是镜头的相对光圈值。
F1.4, F2.8 and friends are relative aperture values.
数值越小物理光圈越大，越大越小。
Smaller numbers mean a bigger physical opening.
这个相反的概念常常把人搞混。
That inversion confuses a lot of people.
scenes.speak: F1.4, F2.8 and friends are relative aperture values. Smaller numbers mean a bigger physical opening. That inversion confuses a lot of people.

scenes.title_cn: F值等于焦距除以入瞳径
scenes.context: 光圈F值等于焦距除以入瞳径，也就是焦距与入瞳径的比值。而入瞳径很大程度上正是由这个物理光圈所控制的。什么是入瞳径？我们可以理解为从镜头前看向其内部的视觉开孔直径。它并不是真实的光圈叶片所控制的物理孔径。很多大光圈镜头前镜组采用高曲率或高折射率的镜片，其作用就是把入瞳径放大。
sentences: 光圈F值等于焦距除以入瞳径。
The F-number equals focal length over the entrance pupil.
入瞳径是从镜头前看向内部的视觉开孔直径。
The entrance pupil is the opening you see from the front.
大光圈镜头用高折射率镜片放大入瞳径。
Fast lenses use high-curvature elements to enlarge the pupil.
scenes.speak: The F-number equals focal length over the entrance pupil. The entrance pupil is the opening you see from the front. Fast lenses use high-curvature elements to enlarge the pupil.

practice: F1.4 and F2.8 are relative apertures, not sizes.
The F-number is focal length divided by the entrance pupil.
It's the opening you see from the front of the lens.
pitfalls: Think F16 is a bigger hole.
A larger f-number means a smaller physical opening.
数值越大物理光圈越小。
Mistake the blades for the pupil.
The pupil is the apparent opening, shaped by front glass too.
入瞳径是视觉开孔直径。
Expect small f-numbers to always mean huge pupils.
The pupil also depends on focal length and front optics.
入瞳径还受焦距和前组镜片影响。
shifts: 用 relative aperture（相对光圈）、focal length（焦距）、ratio（比值）
用 entrance pupil（入瞳）、physical aperture（物理光圈）、apparent opening（视觉开孔）
